entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling about my new VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just so disappointed. I think it might be broken.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's definitely a fault. The main reason I bought it, the pulse tracking, is not working at all. The readings are erratic, and sometimes it won't sync for hours. For what I paid, I feel like it's completely defective.

I see, that's certainly not the experience we want for our customers. A tracker that won't sync is a serious problem. Let me just pull up your account. Can I get the email address you used for the order?
Sure, it's sadie.vance@email.com. I've been a loyal VeloFit user for years, I've never had a product that was just... broken like this. I saved up for this upgrade, you know?
I understand your frustration, and I appreciate your loyalty, Ms. Vance. Thank you for that information... Okay, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you 44 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. Is... is that a problem? I was so worried I waited too long, I just really needed this money back if it's not going to work.

Not a problem at all. I've just checked our policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. Since you're reporting it as defective, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh! Really? You can do that? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so stressed about this. You've been a huge help.

Of course, I'm happy I could get this resolved for you. I have processed the return authorization. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be issued once we receive it.
That's perfect. Thank you again, Isaac. You've made my day.
You're very welcome, Ms. Vance. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
